info.title: DuckyDeck Studio HTTP REST API
info.description:
Local and LAN HTTP REST API for **DuckyDeck Studio**, a native Linux (Rust + CXX-Qt + KDE Plasma 6 Kirigami) configurator and automation daemon for the **duckyPad Pro** (`0x0483:0xd11d`) and **duckyPad (2020)** (`0x0483:0xd11c`).

### Authentication
When **Require API Token Authentication** is enabled (recommended and on by default), every request except `GET /api/v1/health`, `GET /api/v1/openapi.json`, `GET /api/v1/swagger.json`, and `GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml` must include the API token via either:
- `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- `X-API-Token: <token>`

Token comparison uses a constant-time byte comparison to prevent timing side-channel attacks.

get.description: Returns server liveness, version, and whether Bearer token authentication is required. Does not require authentication.
Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger JSON specification for the DuckyDeck Studio REST API.
Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 YAML specification for the DuckyDeck Studio REST API.

get.summary: Full device, profile, SD card, and auto-switcher status
get.description: Returns live hardware connection state, model, firmware version, serial number, active profile, microSD storage summary, and auto-switcher status. Also accessible at `GET /api/v1`.
Returns the active profile number and an array of all loaded profiles (up to 64 on duckyPad Pro).

post.description: Creates a new profile with the given `name`, or duplicates an existing profile when `duplicateFrom` is provided.

duplicateFrom.description: Optional existing profile number to clone slots and settings from

post.summary: Select and optionally switch hardware to a profile
post.description: Selects a profile in DuckyDeck Studio and switches the physical duckyPad over USB HID when `switchHardware` is `true` (default).

switchHardware.description: If true, sends HID GOTO_PROFILE to the connected duckyPad

post.summary: Move a profile to a new index
post.description: Reorders profiles by moving `fromProfile` to `toProfile` and renumbering folders sequentially.

get.summary: Get full profile details including properties and all 26 slots

put.summary: Update profile properties (colors, rotation, webhook, hardware directives)
put.description: Updates profile properties such as `name`, `bgColor`, `hasKeydownColor`, `keydownColor`, `dimUnusedKeys`, `oledRotation` (`0|90|180|270`), `widgetRotation` (`-1|0|90|180|270`), `isUpperHs`, `extraConfigLines`, and `webhook`. Partial updates are merged with existing properties.

delete.description: Deletes the specified profile (at least one profile must remain).

get.summary: List all 26 key & rotary encoder slots in a profile
get.description: Returns slots 1..20 (mechanical keys) and 21..26 (rotary encoders 1 & 2 CCW/CW/Push) for the specified profile.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: 1-based slot index (1..20 for mechanical keys, 21..26 for rotary encoders)

get.summary: Get configuration and duckyScript for a single slot

put.summary: Update labels, RGB color, duckyScript, or host command for a slot

delete.summary: Clear a slot back to unconfigured state

post.summary: Trigger a slot's host action (shell command, Home Assistant action, or HTTP webhook)
post.description: Executes the host-side action (`# @HOST_APP`, `# @HA_ACTION`, or `# @WEBHOOK`) configured on the given profile and slot.

post.summary: Compile duckyScript 3 source into DSVM bytecode (.dsb)
post.description: Runs the DuckyDeck Studio DSVM compiler/validator on the supplied duckyScript source and returns diagnostics, bytecode size, CRC32, and hex-encoded `.dsb` bytes.

get.summary: List all built-in and user-saved key templates

put.summary: Update one or more Persistent Global Variables (PGV 1-16)
put.description: Accepts either `{ "index": 1, "value": 42 }` for a single variable or `{ "values": [{ "index": 1, "value": 42 }] }` for batch updates.

post.summary: Update Persistent Global Variables (alias for PUT)
Live-override per-key RGB LEDs or restore profile LEDs over USB HID
post.description:
Controls physical RGB LEDs on the connected duckyPad over USB HID:
- Set `"restore": true` to exit software LED override mode and restore hardware profile colors.
- Provide `"colorHex": "#ff0055"` (and optional `"slot": 1..20`) or `"leds": [{ "slot": 1, "colorHex": "#00ff88" }]` to set live software LED colors.

restore.description: If true, restores hardware profile LED colors

slot.description: Optional single key slot (1..20); if omitted with colorHex, sets all 20 keys

post.summary: Sync all profiles and compiled .dsb bytecode to the duckyPad microSD card

sdRootPath.description: Optional explicit mount path; if omitted, uses detected microSD mount or USB HID SD mode

post.summary: Reload profiles from microSD card or local cache
Reboot duckyPad Pro into USB Mass Storage (microSD Card) mode
Flush, unmount, and eject mounted duckyPad microSD card
Put connected duckyPad into sleep mode (OLED & LEDs off)
Wake connected duckyPad from sleep mode
Soft-reboot connected duckyPad into normal operating mode
Synchronize duckyPad Pro real-time clock (RTC) with host system time

widgetRotation.description: Desktop OLED Widget orientation override (-1 = follow oledRotation, or 0/90/180/270)

l1.description: Hardware OLED line 1 (max 5 chars in portrait, 4 in landscape)

l2.description: Hardware OLED line 2 (max 5 chars in portrait, 4 in landscape)

wl1.description: Extended Desktop Widget label line 1 (up to 14 chars, host-only)

wl2.description: Extended Desktop Widget label line 2 (up to 14 chars, host-only)
